questions.question_text: At which point on the curve $y = x^2 - 7x + 10$ does the tangent have an angle of inclination of $45^{\circ}$?

options.why: Found $x = 4$ correctly but omitted the constant term $+10$ when substituting back into the curve, giving $16 - 28 = -12$.
Moved the $-7$ to the wrong side of $2x - 7 = 1$, writing $2x = 1 - 7 = -6$ and so $x = -3$.
Moved the $-7$ to the wrong side to get $x = -3$ and also omitted the constant term $+10$ when substituting, giving $9 + 21 = 30$.

questions.question_text: Find the point on the parabola $y = 6x - x^2$ where the tangent has an angle of inclination of $135^{\circ}$?

options.why: Evaluated $x^2$ as $2x$ when substituting, giving $21 - 7 = 14$ instead of $21 - 12.25$.
Divided $-2x = -7$ by positive $2$ instead of by $-2$, giving $x = -3.5$.
Divided $-2x = -7$ by positive $2$ to get $x = -3.5$ and also evaluated $x^2$ as $2x$, giving $-21 - (-7) = -14$.

questions.question_text: Find the points on the cubic $y = x^3 - 11x + 2$ where the tangent has an angle of inclination of $45^{\circ}$.
